main_text.p: 2.in T.Jon.& Hier. Sic עלמא תהי ובהי Mundus infor-mis & inanis, Exo.12.42. in T. Hierosol.
[illegible, ~6 letters] Syr. Stupor, Luc.21.35. Potest etiam referri ad תור.
תהם תהומא, תהום Ch. Abyssus, Syr. [illegible, ~5 letters], Luc.8.31.
תהר [illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Mirari, admirari, stupere, obstu-pescere.
תוא Ch. Conclave, cubiculum, thalamus. Plur. תוי, תויא, תוין.
תון Chal. [illegible, ~4 letters], [illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. Idem, 1.Reg.22.25. Plural. תוניא Deut.32.25. Syr. [illegible, ~4 letters] Lucae 12.3.

תוב Ch.& Syr. Reverti, redire, convertere se, converti: Resipiscere, poenitere, poenitentiam agere: Avertere se, averti, retroagi, recedere. Aphel אתיב Redire, reverti fecit, reduxit, retulit, reportavit, reposuit, restituit, reddidit, rependit: Vomuit, evomuit, Prov.23.8.& 25.16. Convertit, avertit, pervertit, perversum reddidit: Item Respondit: & latius, Loquutus, prolocutus, effatus est, ut Psalm.119.172. Ithpahel אתותב Reddi, restitui, reduci: Respōsum accipere, exaudiri: & ex alia forma, Fut. יתתב Reddetur, Jesa.3.11. Part. מתתב Exauditur, Jesa.53.7.
תוב Ch.& Syr. Rursum, iterum, adhuc, amplius, pr̄e-terea,

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are rendered only approximately; the many Oriental characters and vowel points could not be read reliably and are marked illegible where unclear. The first line of the page continues from the previous page.
